log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Provide a compact reference for Python numeric operations, their results, and links to fuller documentation.","tasks":["Find an operation by its expression or function name.","Read across a row to understand its result.","Compare related operations and locate available documentation."],"relations":["Each row associates an operation with its result and, where provided, a documentation link.","Related arithmetic expressions and function calls share the same lookup structure."],"roles":["The first column identifies the operation and acts as the primary lookup key.","The middle column explains the result and contains the longest prose.","The last column identifies optional documentation links; blank cells indicate no link is shown.","The header labels the three distinct column roles."],"keep_whole":["Operation expressions and function calls, including their arguments, should remain on one line.","Documentation function names and individual words should remain whole."],"may_wrap":["Result descriptions can wrap at natural word boundaries.","The Full documentation header can wrap between its two words."],"same_scale":["Operation entries should have a consistent column width and visual treatment.","Result descriptions should align consistently, as should documentation links."],"h_vs_v":"A wider result column reduces wrapping in the longest description, while compact operation and documentation columns preserve lookup clarity. A narrower table leaves more viewport whitespace at the cost of additional vertical lines."},"designs":[{"widths":[128,432,159],"strategy":"Use the full viewport with a generous result column while keeping all operation entries and the documentation header on one line."},{"widths":[150,439,130],"strategy":"Favor the result column and give operation expressions extra breathing room, allowing the documentation header to wrap."},{"widths":[128,350,159],"strategy":"Set a compact table with visible space to its right, accepting more wrapping in result descriptions while retaining a single-line documentation header."}]}
